page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (small marks and short notes beside lines); a catchword-like line "pideis" at the foot is part of the text line with a ornament.

main_text.p: altarium multitudinem stupendâ, & quòd n. Simi. illa mortuis consecrata, quin & ignoto Deo, le, quòd ad altare thure supplicatum: Si imagines in templa, non hominum solummodò sed & bestiarum, & magno quidem numero introductas, & quòd praeter flores ac coronas, suffitu etiam vel incenso, cereis, sacrificiis, jejuniis, precum battologiis, anathematis, tabellas appendendo, in quibus morbi curati inscripti fuerint, & ex cera, hominis, vituli, ovis & gallinae, &c. imagunculas & oscilla efformata ad Divorum fana adferendo, atq; aliis divinis honoribus, religiosè venerabantur: Si aquam lustralem, quâ animi labes tollatur, & castimonia corporis praestetur, & quâ Sacerdos ad templi januas consistens, ingredientes aspergat: Si Baaliticos Sacerdotes, qui flagris ipsi se concidebant: Haec igitur, & multo plura si spectare, si recensere animus sit; quid erit, amabo te, in quo Ethnicos sibi non appponant, quos imitentur, Jesuitae?

Quid? quòd Ethnicos ipsos, cognitionis verè veri Dei ignaros, à Papicolis superatos constat? Quanto enim horribilior horum superstitio, quòd aquam lustralem mortuorum sepulchris & tumbis laz. ihidetertuupideis

page.notes: Marginal notes are small and partly illegible; the note marks "n. Simi.", "le,", "z. ihi", "detert" and "uu" are reproduced as far as legible. The last line is partly obscured by a damaged ornament; "pideis" is read from the scan and may be incomplete.
